kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتصاعب (form VI)
# نَتَصَاعَبُ (nataṣāʕabu) /na.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# نَتَصَاعَبَ (nataṣāʕaba) /na.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# نَتَصَاعَبْ (nataṣāʕab) /na.ta.sˤaː.ʕab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
